note: From the ACT Government cat pages, read on 2026-10-13. Rules change, so check the page before relying on this.
items: Containment: all cats born on or after 1 July 2022 must be kept on your premises 24 hours a day. Older cats only need containment if you live in one of the declared containment suburbs (17 are listed on the ACT Government page, e.g. Bonner, Crace, Gungahlin Town Centre east).
Registration is compulsory for cats over 8 weeks old that have been in the ACT for 28 days or more (and whose keeper has lived in the ACT for 28 days). Renewal is annual and free.
Microchipping: all cats must be microchipped. Cats can be microchipped at any age.
Desexing: your cat must be desexed unless it is under 3 months old or you hold a sexually entire permit.
